title: Modern Treasury hero
description: A centred white hero: one big tight neo-grotesk headline (three short lines on phones), a muted two-line lead, a solid and an outlined square button with arrows, and a wide, short media slot for a diagram or video below. A faint square grid fades in from the top-right corner behind it.
notes: the media slot is 2.76:1 from md up and 4:3 on phones (the original swaps its video)
content-sized, not window-sized, like the original
